# Propose approved learnings for other repositories

Use this skill after `dream` has promoted general, control-bearing learnings. It reconciles those learnings into target repositories and writes reviewable plans. It never merges or executes changes in the targets.

## When to use it

Use `apply-learnings` when an approved fleet learning should be considered by one or more pack-consuming repos. Use [updatepack](#skill-updatepack) instead when the learning has become part of a pack revision that repos should pull.

## What you need

You need the local learning store, target repository paths, and access to each target's defect-class register. A target without the pack is skipped.

## Try it

Slash-command harnesses:

```text
/apply-learnings --repos C:\Projects\harbortasks,C:\Projects\dockledger
```

Codex equivalent:

```text
$apply-learnings --repos C:\Projects\harbortasks,C:\Projects\dockledger
```

## What happens

The skill loads approved general learnings, opens each target's actual register, classifies each learning as add, merge, conflict or skip, strips sensitive specifics at the boundary, and writes a plan per repo.

## What you get

Illustrative artifact shape:

```text
learnings/plans/harbortasks.plan.md
  add: 2
  merge: 1
  conflict: 1
  skip: 3
```

The plan is the deliverable. A human applies it manually or by PR.

## Review before continuing

Check conflicts carefully. An incoming learning must not duplicate or contradict an existing local directive. Confirm no personal data, secrets or repo-specific raw details crossed into the plan.

## Tips and recovery

Use a manifest when targeting differs per learning. If a learning lacks a control, skip it; prose memory alone is not enough to distribute.

## Where to go next

Apply approved target plans manually, or use [dream](#skill-dream) again after targets produce their own evidence.
